  SPECIAL MEETING

  COUNCIL (Government Code Section 54956)

  TO THE MEMBERS OF THE INGLEWOOD CITY COUNCIL
NOTICE IS HEREBY ORDERED by the Mayor that a special meeting of the City
Council will be held on Tuesday, October 4, 2022, at 3:00 p.m., in the Council
Chambers, One Manchester Boulevard, Inglewood, California (Government Code
Section 54956)
  *****NOTE FROM THE CITY*****
  COVID-19 PUBLIC SERVICE ANNOUNCEMENT REGARDING SPECIAL
  MEETINGS OF
THE INGLEWOOD CITY COUNCIL AND OTHER CITY LEGISLATIVE BODIES

Until further notice, meetings of the Inglewood City Council and other City legislative bodies will be conducted
pursuant to California Government Code section 54953(e), which allows the City to use teleconferencing for
members of the public to access a meeting and to address the legislative body via a call-in option.

CALL-IN OPTION

1. Members of the public who wish to address the City Council orally must use the public access option
 members of the public to access a meeting and to address the legislative body via a call-in option.

CALL-IN OPTION

1. Members of the public who wish to address the City Council orally must use the public access option
  noted below:
  l Members of the public may listen and make oral public comments telephonically by dialing:

  l Dial-in for Special Open Session: 1-669-900-6833 Meeting ID: 825 5030 7638

Passcode: 024788

In the event of a disruption which prevents the City from broadcasting the special meeting to the public using
the call-in option, or in the event of a disruption within the City’s control which prevents the public from
offering public comments using the call-in option, the City Council and other legislative body shall take no
further action on items appearing on the special meeting agenda until public access to the special meeting via
the call-in option.

ALTERNATIVE METHODS

The City also provides alternative methods for members of the public to submit comments and/or to observe a
public meeting. The following alternative methods are provided to the public as a matter of convenience only
and the disruption in service to any alternative method does not preclude the City Council or other legislative
body from taking further action on an agenda item. In the event of a disruption to any alternative method
below members of the public should use the call-in option above.

 1. Submitting Comments Prior to Public Meeting: Members of the public may choose to submit
  comments electronically for consideration by the City Council or other City Legislative Body by sending
  them to the City Clerk/Secretary at athompson@cityofinglewood.org, and Deputy City Clerk at
  aallen@cityofinglewood.org. To ensure distribution to the members of the Legislative Body prior to
  consideration of the agenda, please submit comments prior to 8:00 a.m. the day of the meeting, and in the
  body of the email, please identify the agenda number or subject matter. Correspondence should indicate the
  meeting date and agenda item. Comments received after 8:00 a.m. and prior to the close of the public
  hearings will be made part of the official public record of the meeting. Contact the Office of the City Clerk
  at 310-412-5280 with any questions.

ACCESSIBILITY: If requested, the agenda and backup materials will be made available in appropriate
alternative formats to persons with a disability, as required by Section 202 of the Americans with Disabilities Act
of 1990 (42 U.S.C. Sec. 12132), and the federal rules and regulations adopted in implementation thereof. Any
person who requires a disability-related modification or accommodation, or translation services in order to
observe and/or offer public comment may request such reasonable modification, accommodation, or service by
contacting the Office of the City Clerk by telephone at 310-412-5280, FAX at 310-412-5533, One Manchester
Boulevard, First Floor, Inglewood City Hall, Inglewood, CA 90301 or via email to
athompson@cityofinglewood.org and aallen@cityofinglewood.org no later than 24 hours prior to the scheduled
meeting.

Inglewood, California
  October 4, 2022
  The City Council of the City of Inglewood, California held a special meeting on Tuesday,
  October 4, 2022, in the Council Chambers in City Hall of said City.

  Following the Pledge of Allegiance to the flag of our Country, Mayor Butts called the
  City Council into session at the hour of 3:00 p.m.

  The City Clerk announced the presence of a quorum as follows:

  Present:  Council Members Dotson, Padilla, Morales, Faulk, and Mayor Butts;
  and
  Absent: None.

  City officials and personnel present were as follows:

  Aisha L. Thompson  City Clerk
  Artie Fields  City Manager
  Louis Atwell  Assistant City Manager/Public Works Director

  PUBLIC COMMENTS. Mayor Butts inquired if there were any persons present who
  wished to address the City Council on any item on the Agenda.

  There was no response.

301  RESOLUTION NO. 23-06 ADOPTED – “GOOD CAUSE” EXTENSION AND
  CONTINUED OPERATION OF THE SKY POSTERS LOCATED AT 9800
  SOUTH LA CIENEGA BOULEVARD, INGLEWOOD, BEYOND JANUARY 1,
  2023, PURSUANT TO BUSINESS AND PROFESSIONS CODE SECTION
  5273.1(b); MAYOR AUTHORIZED TO SEND THE RESOLUTION ALONG
  WITH A LETTER TO CALIFORNIA DEPARTMENT OF TRANSPORTATION.
  Staff report dated October 4, 2022, was presented recommending that the Mayor and
  Council Members adopt a Resolution finding “good cause” for extension and continued
  operation of the Sky Posters super graphic displays located at 9800 South La Cienega
  Boulevard, Inglewood, beyond January 1, 2023, pursuant to Business & Professions
  Code section 5273.1(b).

  It was moved by Council Member Morales, and seconded by Council Member Dotson
  that the City Council does hereby: 1) Adopt Resolution No. 23-06 entitled:

  RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  INGLEWOOD FINDING “GOOD CAUSE” FOR AN EXTENSION OF THE
  CONTINUED EXISTENCE AND OPERATION OF THE SKY POSTERS
  SUPER GRAPHIC DISPLAYS LOCATED AT 9800 SOUTH LA CIENEGA
  BOULEVARD, INGLEWOOD, CALIFORNIA BEYOND JANUARY 1, 2023
  PURSUANT TO BUSINESS & PROFESSIONS CODE SECTION 5273.1 (b)

  and; 2) Authorize the Mayor to send the Resolution along with a letter to California
  Department of Transportation requesting a “good cause” extension for Sky Posters. The
  motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members Dotson, Padilla, Morales, Faulk, and Mayor Butts; and
  Noes: None.

301  RESOLUTION NO. 23-07 ADOPTED – “GOOD CAUSE” EXTENSION AND
  CONTINUED OPERATION OF THE PEARL MEDIA SUPER GRAPHIC
  DISPLAYS LOCATED AT 9920 SOUTH LA CIENEGA BOULEVARD,
  INGLEWOOD, BEYOND JANUARY 1, 2023, PURSUANT TO BUSINESS AND
  PROFESSIONS CODE SECTION 5273.1(b); MAYOR AUTHORIZED TO SEND
  THE RESOLUTION ALONG WITH A LETTER TO CALIFORNIA
  DEPARTMENT OF TRANSPORTATION. Staff report dated October 4, 2022, was
  presented recommending that the Mayor and Council Members adopt a Resolution
  finding “good cause” for extension and continued operation of the Pearl Media super
  graphic displays located at 9920 South La Cienega Boulevard, Inglewood, beyond
  January 1, 2023, pursuant to Business & Professions Code section 5273.1(b).
 It was moved by Council Member Morales, and seconded by Council Member Faulk that
the City Council does hereby: 1) Adopt Resolution No. 23-07 entitled:

  RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL FOR THE CITY OF
  INGLEWOOD FINDING “GOOD CAUSE” FOR AN EXTENSION OF THE
CONTINUED EXISTENCE AND OPERATION OF THE PEARL MEDIA
  SUPER GRAPHIC DISPLAYS LOCATED AT 9920 SOUTH LA CIENEGA
BOULEVARD, INGLEWOOD, CALIFORNIA BEYOND JANUARY 1, 2023
  PURSUANT TO BUSINESS & PROFESSIONS CODE SECTION 5273.1 (b)

and; 2) Authorize the Mayor to send the Resolution along with a letter to California
Department of Transportation requesting a “good cause” extension for Pearl Media. The
motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
Ayes: Council Members Dotson, Padilla, Morales, Faulk, and Mayor Butts; and
Noes: None.

There being no further business to be presented, Mayor Butts adjourned the meeting at
the hour of 3:02 a.m.

Approved this 15th day of November, 2022.

  Aisha L. Thompson, City Clerk

James Butts, Jr., Mayor
